title: AC1024 associative dimension dependency body reader profile
scope: Dispatch the empirically observed AC1024 ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY class through the associative object reader when its CLASSES record name omits the ACDB prefix.
Decode the dependency-body version, dimension-base version, name, and class version within the framed object and string-stream bounds.
Capture the common object handle and owner, record the exact body span, and preserve strict refusal while the associative graph has no DXF output route.

source.workspaceStatus: Local investigation input; untracked and not committed.

trace.observation: All 17 empirical type-522 objects dispatched through DRW_AssociativeObject and produced complete four-field traces with common owner handles. Each decoded body occupied bits 39..69 in the extracted object frame.

odaSpecification.search: Extracted text was checked for ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY, AssocDimDependencyBody, and dimensionDependencyBody; no matching class layout was present. No DWG layout was inferred from a secondary source in conflict with ODA.

independentParser.schema: BitShort dependency-body version; BitShort dimension-base version; object text name; BitShort class version.

independentReaderWriter.source: include/dwg.h Dwg_Object_ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY and src/dynapi.c field schema
independentReaderWriter.projection: DXF output orders the body fields under AcDbAssocDependencyBody, AcDbImpAssocDimDependencyBodyBase, and AcDbAssocDimDependencyBody subclasses; common owner group 330 points to the owning dependency. This is transport evidence only.

graphObservation.relationship: Each of the 17 body handles is named by an ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY dep_body reference; that dependency is owned by ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP handle 1067, which is owned by ACDBASSOCNETWORK handle 1060.
graphObservation.currentOutputBehavior: dx_iface::addAssociativeObject declines to retain DWG-origin associative shells. The strict CLI continues to refuse complete conversion after parsing the bodies.

implementation.summary: Added typed fields and bounded parsing for the four observed body values. Class dispatch recognizes the source's ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY record name via its normalized CLASSES metadata. The parser records a complete dependency-body prefix and common owner; unrelated and incomplete associative graphs remain unsupported.
behaviorChanges: AC1024 class type 522 body values are available through the existing DRW_AssociativeObject callback instead of falling through the generic custom-object skip path.
The decoder checks both modern object-body and separate string-stream bounds and refuses a truncated name atomically.
Copy and assignment preserve the parsed body fields; a malformed read clears state and permits a corrected retry.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 1/1 in 0.21 seconds; generated AC1024 control verifies field decode, common owner, exact body sentinel, copy/assignment, malformed-name refusal, state clearing, and retry.
results.focusedAsan: PASS 1/1 in 0.36 seconds after rebuilding the owning selector and library in the configured ASan tree.
results.sourceComparison: PASS: all 17 source object handles, common owners, dependency-body versions, dimension-base versions, names, and class versions match LibreDWG 0.14 JSON from the same input hash.
results.strictCli: EXPECTED_REFUSAL: strict-complete conversion still fails because required associative graph data has no complete DWG-to-DXF retention/output path.

limitations: No ACDBASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY DXF writer or complete associative dependency/network/constraint-group output graph is implemented in this slice.
The local sample is not committed and is not an eligible persistent regression fixture.
The source profile does not qualify other DWG versions or other associative subclasses.
No native CAD semantic, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, platform, ABI, whole-document or support-claim gate is promoted.
